mentions.name: BestInterest
mentions.description: This app helps coparents by automatically filtering out anything that isn't child-focused from their coparent's messages, helping ensure court order compliance and reducing conflict.
mentions.problem: Coparents deal with conflict from messages that aren't child-focused and need help staying compliant with court orders.
mentions.source_excerpt: [BestInterest](https://bestinterest.app) helps coparents find peace by automatically filtering out anything that isn't child-focused from their coparent's messages. Ensures court order compliance and reduces conflict.
